about_the_game:
Corebound combines automation and deckbuilding into a unique strategic experience. Battle mysterious constructs as you build production lines to generate the cards you need. Optimize your decks and factories, expand and fight your way to the mountain’s core.

Deckbuilding meets automation

Build and optimize factories to produce the cards that power your decks, then use those cards to take control of the battlefield in turn-based encounters. Complete the loop by forging new buildings from the remains of your defeated foes.

Tactical Deckbuilding

Balance efficiency and combat readiness: every card you play is the product of a system you've engineered. Will you focus on overwhelming power, tactical flexibility, or a variety of different decks to choose from?

Otherworldly constructs

Learn their behavior, exploit their patterns, and overcome increasingly dangerous encounters as you descend deeper.

Helping Hands

You are not alone. These strange little guys work tirelessly by your side. Who or what they are remains a mystery, but their loyalty is unquestionable.
